debates.question: 幸福到底是什么？我们是否应该追求幸福？
debates.question_en: What is happiness, really? And should we even pursue it?

debates.question: AI 时代，人如何夺回注意力与存在的意义？
debates.question_en: In the age of AI, how do we reclaim our attention and the meaning of our existence?

debates.question: AI 取代了人类工作后，人类是否会迎来「存在危机」？普通人怎样面对大面积中年失业的情况？
debates.question_en: After AI replaces human work, will humanity face an 'existential crisis'? And how should ordinary people cope with mass midlife unemployment?

debates.question: 原生家庭的创伤：我们多大程度被童年塑造？能否真正走出来？是否有希望改变父母？
debates.question_en: Trauma from the family we're born into: how much does childhood shape us, can we truly move past it, and is there any hope of changing our parents?

debates.question: AI 与算法：在增强我们，还是在让我们退化？
debates.question_en: AI and algorithms: are they augmenting us, or making us atrophy?

debates.question: AI 时代该怎么养孩子？——拼命鸡娃、挤名校到底还值不值得？
debates.question_en: Raising kids in the age of AI: is intense 'tiger parenting' and chasing elite schools still worth it?

debates.question: 科技大厂的『扁平化』——一个经理带 30–50 人，会成为常态吗？
debates.question_en: Big-tech 'flattening' — one manager over 30–50 reports: is this the new normal?

debates.question: 是否有“造物主”，如果有的话，TA为什么要造出人类？
debates.question_en: Is there a 'Creator'? And if so, why would they have made humankind?

debates.question: 一个好的『管理者』，到底是怎样的？
debates.question_en: What actually makes a good manager?

debates.question: “知道”和“做到”之间的差异是如何产生的？（知道该锻炼、早睡，却很难做到）
debates.question_en: Why is there a gap between knowing and doing? (We know we should exercise and sleep early — yet rarely do.)

debates.question: 人是否应该追求长生，如果人真的能够长生，世界会怎样？
debates.question_en: Should we pursue immortality — and if humans really could live forever, what would the world become?

debates.question: 我们该如何面对死亡？如何做到「向死而生」？
debates.question_en: How should we face death — and how do we actually live 'toward' it (being-toward-death)?

debates.question: 金钱能（在多大程度上）买到幸福？
debates.question_en: Can money buy happiness — and how much?

debates.question: 「只专注于你能控制的」是处世智慧，还是一种对改不了的不公视而不见的特权式逃避？
debates.question_en: Is 'focus only on what you can control' practical wisdom, or a privileged way of looking past injustice you could help change?

debates.question: 现在的年轻人（尤其在亚洲）为什么不想生孩子？这对个人与社会意味着什么？
debates.question_en: Why don't young people — especially in Asia — want children anymore, and what does it mean for the individual and for society?

debates.question: 为什么这一代人越来越难谈恋爱、走入亲密关系？是个人问题，还是时代造的？
debates.question_en: Why is this generation finding it ever harder to date and form intimate relationships — a personal failing, or one the age has made?

debates.question: 儒、释、道的异同：三家分歧究竟在哪，又在何处殊途同归？
debates.question_en: Confucianism, Buddhism, and Daoism: where do the three traditions truly differ, and where do they converge?

debates.question: 普通人投资，该买大盘指数，还是买自己拿着放心的个股？
debates.question_en: For ordinary investors: buy the broad index, or the individual stocks you can hold with confidence?

debates.question: 靠恐惧驱动的优秀（『要够好才配被爱』）该不该放下？放下了，会不会就失去前进的动力？
debates.question_en: Excellence driven by fear ('I must be good enough to deserve love') — should we let it go, and if we do, do we lose the drive to move forward?

debates.question: 东方与西方哲学：源头何以不同，如何塑造了今天的东西方人，又能否融合双方的智慧？
debates.question_en: Eastern and Western philosophy: why did their sources differ, how did that shape the people we are today, and can the two wisdoms be fused?

debates.question: 大型组织里的『组织政治』，是毒瘤还是必需？普通人又该如何看待、甚至善用它？
debates.question_en: In large organizations, is 'office politics' a tumor or a necessity — and how should ordinary people view, even make good use of, it?

debates.question: 家中老人病重、靠插管维持近乎植物人的状态，作为子女，该不该撤管放手？
debates.question_en: When an elderly parent is critically ill and kept in a near-vegetative state by life support, should the children withdraw it and let go?

debates.question: 企业用人，该「以德为先」还是「以才为先」？
debates.question_en: When a company hires and promotes, should it put character first, or ability first?

debates.question: 下属能力或动力不足，领导该花时间 coaching，还是果断 manage out？
debates.question_en: When a subordinate's ability or motivation falls short, should a leader invest time in coaching, or decisively manage them out?

debates.question: 「你眼中的别人不是别人，你眼中的自己不是自己，你眼中的别人才是自己」——这话有道理吗？
debates.question_en: 'The others you see aren't really them, the self you see isn't really you, and the others you see are actually you' — is there truth to this?

debates.question: 父母年迈失能，该亲自接回家照顾，还是送养老院、请护工？
debates.question_en: When parents grow old and frail, should you care for them at home yourself, or place them in a nursing home and hire professional carers?

debates.question: 世俗意义上的『成功』——财富、地位、名声、成就——到底值不值得追求？
debates.question_en: Is worldly 'success' — wealth, status, fame, achievement — worth pursuing at all?

debates.question: 「忠于真实的自我」是不是个伪命题？到底有没有一个本真的我？
debates.question_en: Is 'being true to your authentic self' a false premise — and is there even an authentic self to begin with?

debates.question: 什么样的不平等是可以接受的？
debates.question_en: What kind of inequality is acceptable?

debates.question: 我们的成功与失败，多少是「应得的」？努力真能决定命运吗？
debates.question_en: How much of our success or failure do we actually deserve — and does effort really decide our fate?

debates.question: 该不该用基因编辑「设计」更聪明、更健康的下一代？
debates.question_en: Should we use gene editing to 'design' smarter, healthier children?

debates.question: 该频繁跳槽，还是在一处深耕固守？
debates.question_en: Should you job-hop often, or stay put and dig deep in one place?

debates.question: 生产力一次次飞跃，人是更清闲还是更忙、更幸福还是更不幸？（农业、工业、AI 三次革命）
debates.question_en: With each leap in productivity, do people end up more leisured or busier, happier or unhappier? (The agricultural, industrial, and AI revolutions)

debates.question: 一样东西的价值，到底由什么决定？（劳动、效用、稀缺，还是别的？）
debates.question_en: What ultimately determines the value of a thing? (Labor, utility, scarcity — or something else?)

debates.question: AI 创造的财富，会加剧不平等（赢家通吃的马太效应），还是造就更公平的社会？
debates.question_en: Will the wealth AI creates deepen inequality (a winner-takes-all Matthew effect), or build a fairer society?

debates.question: 想改变自己，该先给自己贴正向标签、强化身份（成功学的『先改 identity』），还是看破『我执』、放下自我（佛学的无我）？
debates.question_en: To change yourself, should you start by claiming a positive label and reinforcing a new identity (the self-help 'identity-first' move), or by seeing through self-grasping and letting go of the self (the Buddhist no-self)?

debates.question: 人是否拥有真正的自由意志？
debates.question_en: Do we have genuine free will?

debates.question: 是地理与物质环境塑造了思想与文明的分野（东西方为何不同），还是思想自有其命（偶然、伟人、观念）？
debates.question_en: Did geography and material conditions shape the divergence of thought and civilization (why East and West differ), or do ideas have a life of their own (contingency, great individuals, the force of ideas)?

debates.question: 这一辈子想活得不后悔，到底该入世（投身事功与人群），还是出世（超脱放下、向内求安）？
debates.question_en: To live this life without regret, should you engage the world (throw yourself into achievement and people), or withdraw from it (transcend, let go, seek peace within)?

debates.question: 为什么我们忍不住跟别人比？嫉妒能消除吗？
debates.question_en: Why can't we stop comparing ourselves to others? Can envy ever be eliminated?

debates.question: 如果有了足够的钱（财务自由），是否还应该继续工作？
debates.question_en: If you had enough money to never need to, should you still work?

debates.question: 量子物理是否说明「观测」真的改变了世界？
debates.question_en: Does quantum physics show that 'observation' really changes the world?

debates.question: AI 时代，人的心智该往「深」练还是往「广」练？
debates.question_en: In the AI era, should the mind train for depth or for breadth?

debates.question: 品德是教出来的，还是长出来的？——美德到底可不可教？
debates.question_en: Can virtue be taught — is character instilled, or does it grow on its own?
